task.description:
WF-03 Step 03 (BACKEND-DEV) for GH-766. Implement the fix per src/design/iss-gh766-appendeventintx-idempotency.md.

You are on branch feature/WF03-GH766-20260813. Verify with git branch --show-current before making changes.

Implementation steps:
1. Read src/design/iss-gh766-appendeventintx-idempotency.md in full.
2. Read src/scheduler/scheduler.zig focusing on appendEventInTx (around line 913).
3. Read tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig focusing on TC-SCH-02-03 (around line 1213).

4. Change appendEventInTx: After the existing events INSERT exec (which inserts the TIMER_FIRED event), add a third conn.exec that INSERTs into plat_event_idempotency. The SQL:
   INSERT INTO plat_event_idempotency (idempotency_key, event_id, created_at)
   SELECT $1, event_id, created_at FROM events WHERE instance_id = $2::uuid AND idempotency_key = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
   Parameters: &.{ idem_key, instance_id_text }
   The catch clause: catch return SchedulerError.TransactionFailed
   This must be placed BEFORE the UPDATE instance_projections exec.

5. Change TC-SCH-02-03 in sch02_timer_polling_test.zig: After the existing pre-seed INSERT into events (which inserts the conflicting event), add a second conn.exec that also pre-inserts into plat_event_idempotency:
   INSERT INTO plat_event_idempotency (idempotency_key, event_id, created_at) VALUES ($1, gen_random_uuid(), NOW())
   Parameters: &.{conflicting_idem}
   This must be placed BEFORE the scheduler.pollDueTimers call.

6. Run: zig build
   Must exit 0.

7. Run: zig build test
   Must exit 0.

8. Run: zig build test-integration-sch02 (requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test)
   Must pass with TC-SCH-02-03 green.

9. Commit: git add src/scheduler/scheduler.zig tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig src/design/iss-gh766-appendeventintx-idempotency.md
   git commit -m 'fix(scheduler): GH-766 appendEventInTx writes to plat_event_idempotency for dedup enforcement'
   git push origin feature/WF03-GH766-20260813

Do NOT change:
- Any migration files
- src/db/event_store.zig or similar
- build.zig
acceptance_criteria: appendEventInTx has new exec: INSERT INTO plat_event_idempotency SELECT ... FROM events WHERE idempotency_key=$1

result.summary: Implemented GH-766 fix: appendEventInTx now writes to plat_event_idempotency (exec 2) using SELECT subquery from events for accurate event_id/created_at. TC-SCH-02-03 pre-seeds plat_event_idempotency with conflicting_idem to restore PK-violation path post-migration-1147. zig build, zig build test, and zig build test-integration-sch02 all exit 0.
